text: Moon's Surface
Kaguya
Kaguya
Pelulu
Fubbit
[ff6464]Otsukimi Event has ended.[ffffff]
Hmm...
Long time no see! How have you been?
...Oh, it's you and Pelulu. Long time no see...
You look kinda gloomy~. Also, why are you sighing?
Actually...Someone has proposed to me...
What? Isn't that a good thing? Congrats~!
Hm? You don't seem to be very excited about it.\nDo you hate him that much?
I was proposed by...Fubbit, the ruler of a place\ncalled "Uraluna" on the far side of this moon...
The ruler proposed to you?! He must be rich and\nthat's good!
Fubbit, who accidentally fell in love with me,\nnow shows up here almost every day, urging me to\nmarry him...
I purposely made an absurd request, hoping he\nwould give up...
I said I'd think about it if he brought me a\n"White Gemstone Container", an "Everwarming Coat"\nor other treasures...Then he brought me this...
Huh? What's this junk~?
I never thought that he'd actually found a\ntreasure...
Uhm~, I wouldn't call that a treasure, looks more\nlike a homemade piece of junk to me...How could\nyou believe that it's a treasure?
So basically, you hate that Fubbit guy and you\nwanna reject him, but you don't wanna hurt his\nfeelings, right?
I don't like him, but I don't hate him either.\nIt's just that...
Ah, there you are, Usakichi and Usami! I've been\nwondering where you've been!
Huh? Wait a minute, you're not Usakichi and Usami,\nare you...?
They say, "...We're Hopson and Hopsie from\nUraluna...!"
What? Who's that?
There you are! This time it's the real Usakichi\nand Usami!
They say, "...Get out of our territory and go back\nto Uraluna...!"
They say, "...Shut up! We're here to protect\nMaster Fubbit! You guys step back...!"
They say, "...What?! You guys wanna learn it the\nhard way, don't ya...?!"
Why are they fighting all of a sudden?
That's just how they are...\nThe inhabitants of the moon and Uraluna have been\non bad terms for ages.
If Fubbit and I got married, a war might break\nout...
I see, so that's one of the reasons you're turning\nhim down.
However, there's only way to solve this problem...\nIf I use the power of my tail...
Come to think of it, I feel like you had mentioned\nabout it before...So what exactly is the power of\nyour tail?
You fool! You're embarrassing me!\nStop it right now!
Is he the ruler who is causing all the trouble?\nHe's more attractive than I imagined.\nNot a bad choice to be your fiancé, right?
I'm here for you again, Lady Kaguya...
Seeing you is all I need to keep me going and get\nthrough today...
Wow, what a cheesy guy...
...But honestly, I don't really understand what\nhe's saying~.
The treasure that you requested, a "Flying Clam",\nI've brought it for you too.
Um, you've found it...?
It seems that he's brought her another piece of\njunk~. But she's okay with it. Maybe they're\nactually a match made in heaven.
Lady Kaguya, please marry me!
As I told you before, I can't marry you...
Ha, I understand! Hop! I must bring you the last\nbeautiful treasure, a "Gemstone Branch", right?
No, that's not the problem...
Don't worry! I'll go anywhere to find it to be\nable to marry you, hop!
Just like a cradle sailing on a big ship, my\nsuccess is guaranteed!
Argh~!! Stop it~!! You've been blabbering on and\non for a while now, but I don't really understand\nwhat you're saying!!
Hmm? Who are you?
They're my precious servants...
Since when did we become your servants?
I see...
Hmph...
Lady Kaguya! Let me compete with them to see who\ncan bring the "Gemstone Branch" here!
Well, sure...
Hey, we never agree to compete with you!
To prove that I'm competent and worthy of being\nKaguya's fiancé, I need some good supporting\ncharacters like you! Hop!
If she sees that I can do everything better than\nher precious servants,
she'll surely fall head over heels in love with\nme!
Argh~! Again, I don't understand what you're\ntalking about~! Moreover, why do keep saying "hop"\nrandomly?!
It's just something I say out of habit when I get\nexcited.
Grrr!! This is kinda annoying~! You talk so much,\nbut it's all just empty talk, it's terrible!!
I'd like you to accept Fubbit's challenge...\nHe'll prolly give up the idea of marrying me if he\nloses here.
Hmm, I don't think he'll give up so easily though.\nHe seems pretty tough to me.
And of course, I'll reward you generously...
Welp, I'm fine as long as there's a reward!\nHonestly, I just wanna knock that oddball down a\npeg!
That's great...
All right, the winner is the first one who brings\na "Gemstone Branch" here...Let the game begin!
Okay, let's do this!
I've brought the "Gemstone Branch" you requested.\nI feel a hundred times braver and my chest is\nbursting with excitement when I think about
marrying Lady Kaguya! Hop! Getting a treasure like\nthis for you was a cinch!
Fubbit...
Lady Kaguya, I understand your concern. You're\nworried about the tension between the moon and\nUraluna, right?
So you were aware of it?
Don't worry...Just like Uraluna, I've been\ndiligently studying the moon.
Once we get married, I'll make sure to govern the\nmoon properly too!
I'm not very sure about that~.
Oh, it's you guys! It's too late for you to bring\nthat treasure here now though. The game is over,\nI've already won!
I've got to give it to you because you actually\nunderstand Kaguya. But someone who steals can't\nbe a leader!
Are you calling me a thief?! Even if you're\nsomeone whom Lady Kaguya trusts a lot, I can't\nforgive you if you say that!
Alright, then tell us where you got the branch\npart to make that "Gemstone Branch"!
I found it in the wild so I don't see anything\nwrong with that!
But we found it first~! I even carved the letter\n"P" and circled it at the bottom!
There's indeed a circled P...Due to foul play,\nthe winner of this challenge will be the\nadventurer...
N-no way...
You musta underestimated the spirit of a merchant!\nI'd fight tooth and nail to keep anything that's\nmine, even if it's just a pebble!!
Dammit, it was completely an accident beyond my\ncontrol...
How dare you made me look bad in front of Lady\nKaguya! Now I'll do whatever it takes to beat you!
What? What are you gonna do now?
The moon and Uraluna...I believe I'm the only one\ncapable of governing both! While risking this,\nI'd like to challenge you once again!
Lady Kaguya! This is gonna be my first and last\nwish, hop! I'd like you to organize and decide the\nrules for this challenge!
F-fine...
Hey, we'll see who wins tomorrow!\nDon't even think about running away!
As you have heard...I'd like you to accept this\nchallenge. I'll give you more rewards...
You think Fubbit will give up if he loses again\nthis time~?
That's part of it. It's just that Fubbit is\nserious, so I feel bad for him if you avoid the\nchallenge...
Although I'll be the one who organizes it. I won't\ntell you anything because I want it to be fair...
I see~. Welp, at this point I want the adventurer\nto beat that guy too~.
Therefore, it's time to study about the moon and\nUraluna! Let's spend the night cramming together!
